title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics priority-weighting + slo-toolkit context enrichment
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Enhances on-call diagnostics by weighting runbook suggestions with SLO context; no behavioral changes to incident dispatching, opt-in via config.
description: Motivation: on-call engineers frequently receive many candidate runbooks and diagnostic hints during an SLO incident. This PR improves ranking by combining incident-bot heuristics with SLO-toolkit signals (error budget remaining, SLI volatility, recent regressions) to surface higher-precision suggestions. Changes: (1) adds a lightweight priority-weighting module that scores runbooks and diagnostics by SLO context and recent alert cadence; (2) enriches incident context with SLO metadata from slo-toolkit utilities (service owner, error budget, burn rate); (3) exposes a config flag to enable weighted ranking per-team and a migration path that preserves previous behavior by default; (4) updates runbook linking logic to prefer compact actionable steps when the estimated time-to-recovery is low. This PR includes unit and integration tests, documentation for on-call config, and a small migration note. Related: ENG-2109, SRE-4112, SUP-342. Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed by SRE - [x] unit tests added - [x] e2e on staging green - [x] docs updated - [x] feature flagged for gradual rollout
